europe_now.title: Pope Leo XIV's historic visit to France
europe_now.summary: Pope Leo XIV has arrived in France for his first state visit in eighteen years, drawing massive crowds of hundreds of thousands of people to Paris for an open-air Mass. The Pope is engaging with sexual abuse survivors, migrants, and marginalized communities while delivering messages of coexistence and peace in a secular society.

europe_now.title: Deadly building explosion near the Acropolis in Athens
europe_now.summary: A powerful explosion destroyed a building close to the Acropolis in Athens, resulting in multiple casualties and leaving several people missing. The incident claimed the lives of at least six individuals, including a British national, prompting an immediate emergency response and investigation.

top_stories.title: Papal Visit to France
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV arrived in France for his first state visit in eighteen years, drawing hundreds of thousands of worshippers to Paris for a massive open-air Mass. During the trip, the Pope met with sexual abuse survivors, migrants, and marginalized groups while emphasizing the possibility of living together in dignity and peace within a secular society.

top_stories.title: Athens Acropolis Explosion
top_stories.summary: A destructive explosion occurred in a building close to the Acropolis in Athens, causing multiple fatalities and leaving several individuals missing. The incident resulted in the deaths of at least six people, including a British national, prompting local authorities to launch an investigation.
